Deposit $50 of USDC into the largest alphagrowth vault on Base and hold the vault shares. Cost: $50 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Claim any yield the vault paid, then redeposit it into the same vault so the balance compounds. Cost: about $3 of gas, plus the $25 moved. Time: 15 minutes.
Check the vault's yield, harvest what it paid, and redeposit it instead of letting it sit idle. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Open alphagrowth's own docs and points page from its official site, and complete any quest or task it lists for this week; if it runs no points program yet, join its governance forum or community channel and read the latest proposal. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 15 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot, then check alphagrowth's own announcements before you withdraw. Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 30 days, then 10 minutes to unwind.
